items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Flagg at that time was there before he went to the DuSable. He was a bellboy that became the manager and built that hotel.

ctx.x: HINTON: This is unbelievable... Here's a guy, Bill Pemberton, who helped me in talking to and taping Perry Bradford.

Back to Chick. When Chick Webb died we were in Chicago, staying on 39th Street, and they wouldn't tell me in two days, because they knew good and well I would go to pieces. Nobody would tell me that Chick Webb was dead. You know how I always go over my newspaper. They wouldn't give me nothing. Flagg at that time was there before he went to the DuSable.
